digest.component_or_area: reconciler rich-text send path + baseline state management
propositions: DC and Cloud send paths must render rich-text (wiki for DC, ADF for Cloud) exactly once without looping, tracked by an 8-byte per-binding digest of the rendered wire and a change-gated re-emit counter that triggers one observational GET at threshold 2

A no-op pass (local unchanged from baseline) must emit zero updates and persist zero new baseline entries, with the state mechanism invisible when the cutover flag is OFF or the rendering library is unavailable

Concurrent both-sides edits to a body keep local-wins semantics and raise an outbound-field-conflict alert; the baseline compare normalizes only the local side through the codec while emit compares plain inbound-decoded remote against normalized fit local
The two DC CREATE sites (_issues._translate_create_fields and backend._map_local_to_dc_fields) must both compose to_wire(fit_outbound(...)) so rendered wiki ships on creation like it does on updates

The WikiTextCodec.normalize_outbound redefinition to decode(to_wire(t)) for DC must not shift the comment-diff dedup key, which uses the identity codec and must converge without re-posting already-mirrored comments
